title: Text 1
subtitle: 欧洲君主制困境：西班牙国王卡洛斯退位

sentences.en: King Juan Carlos of Spain once insisted "kings don't abdicate, they die in their sleep".
sentences.zh: 西班牙国王胡安·卡洛斯曾坚称“国王不会退位，他们会在睡梦中死去”。

sentences.en: But embarrassing scandals and the popularity of the republican left in the recent Euro- elections have forced him to eat his words and stand down.
sentences.zh: 但是令人难堪的丑闻和共和派左翼政党在最近欧洲议会选举中的得势，迫使他收回前言并退位。

sentences.en: So, does the Spanish crisis suggest that monarchy is seeing its last days?
sentences.zh: 那么，西班牙的危机是否表明君主制已日薄西山？

sentences.en: Does that mean the writing is on the wall for all European royals, with their magnificent uniforms and majestic lifestyles?
sentences.zh: 这是否意味着，对于所有身着华丽制服、过着气派生活的欧洲王室成员而言，末日已到？

sentences.en: The Spanish case provides arguments both for and against monarchy.
sentences.zh: 西班牙的例子为支持与反对君主制的论点都提供了依据。

sentences.en: When public opinion is particularly polarised, as it was following the end of the Franco regime, monarchs can rise above "mere" politics and "embody" a spirit of national unity.
sentences.zh: 在民意严重两极分化之时，例如佛朗哥政权倒台后的那段时期，君主可以超越“纯粹”的政治，从而“体现”民族团结的精神。

sentences.en: It is this apparent transcendence of politics that explains monarchs' continuing popularity as heads of state.
sentences.zh: 正是这种对政治的超越，解释了君主作为国家元首为何一直深受欢迎。

sentences.en: And so, the Middle East excepted, Europe is the most monarch- infested region in the world, with 10 kingdoms (not counting Vatican City and Andorra).
sentences.zh: 因此，除中东以外，欧洲是世界上君主制最多的地区，共有十个王国（不包括梵蒂冈城和安道尔）。

sentences.en: But unlike their absolutist counterparts in the Gulf and Asia, most royal families have survived because they allow voters to avoid the difficult search for a non-controversial but respected public figure.
sentences.zh: 但是，与海湾和亚洲地区专制的君主不同，欧洲大多数王室之所以能够存续下来，是因为他们使选民免于费力去寻找一个无争议而又受人尊敬的公众人物。

sentences.en: Even so, kings and queens undoubtedly have a downside.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，国王和王后们无疑也有不利的一面。

sentences.en: Symbolic of national unity as they claim to be, their very history — and sometimes the way they behave today — embodies outdated and indefensible privileges and inequalities.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们自称是民族团结的象征，但他们自身的历史——有时还包括他们今天的行为方式——却体现了过时的、站不住脚的特权和种种不平等。

sentences.en: At a time when Thomas Piketty and other economists are warning of rising inequality and the increasing power of inherited wealth, it is bizarre that wealthy aristocratic families should still be the symbolic heart of modern democratic states.
sentences.zh: 在托马斯·皮凯蒂及其他经济学家不断警告不平等加剧、世袭财富影响力增强的当下，富有的贵族世家竟仍然是现代民主国家的象征性核心，这实在匪夷所思。

sentences.en: The most successful monarchies strive to abandon or hide their old aristocratic ways.
sentences.zh: 最成功的君主政体都努力摒弃或掩饰其古老的贵族做派。

sentences.en: Princes and princesses have day-jobs and ride bicycles, not horses (or helicopters).
sentences.zh: 王子和公主们有白天的工作，出行骑自行车而不是马（或直升机）。

sentences.en: Even so, these are wealthy families who party with the international 1%, and media intrusiveness makes it increasingly difficult to maintain the right image.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，这些也是与全球最富有的1%人群一同出入社交场合的富裕家族，而媒体的无孔不入使维护恰当的形象变得越来越困难。

sentences.en: While Europe's monarchies will no doubt be smart enough to survive for some time to come, it is the British royals who have most to fear from the Spanish example.
sentences.zh: 尽管欧洲的君主制无疑足够精明，能够在未来一段时间内存续下去，但西班牙的例子最让英国王室忧心忡忡。

sentences.en: It is only the Queen who has preserved the monarchy's reputation with her rather ordinary (if well-heeled) granny style.
sentences.zh: 正是女王以其相当平实（虽则阔绰）的老奶奶风格维系了君主制的声誉。

sentences.en: The danger will come with Charles, who has both an expensive taste of lifestyle and a pretty hierarchical view of the world.
sentences.zh: 危险将随着查尔斯而来，他既追求奢华的生活方式，又对世界抱有相当强烈的等级观念。

sentences.en: He has failed to understand that monarchies have largely survived because they provide a service — as non- controversial and non-political heads of state.
sentences.zh: 他没有意识到，君主制之所以能大体存续下来，是因为他们提供服务——充当无争议、无政治色彩的国家元首。

sentences.en: Charles ought to know that as English history shows, it is kings, not republicans, who are the monarchy's worst enemies.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯应当明白，正如英国历史所表明的，君主制最大的敌人是国王自己，而不是共和派人士。

questions.stem: According to the first two paragraphs, King Juan Carlos of Spain ____

options.A: used to enjoy high public support.
options.C: eased his relationship with his rivals.

questions.analysis: 事实细节题。根据题干要求，定位到文章前两段。而文章第一段的第二句话提到"But embarrassing scandals and the popularity of the republican left in the recent Euro-elections have forced him to eat his words and stand down."（在最近的欧洲选举中，令人尴尬的丑闻和受欢迎的共和党，均迫使Carlos收回前言并退位）。D选项中，"stand down"是"end reign"的同义置换，且"embarrassment"与导致Carlos卸任的原因"embarrassing scandals"是相呼应的。故D是正确答案。A、B、C均属于无中生有。

questions.stem: Monarchs are kept as heads of state in Europe mostly ____

options.A: owing to their undoubted and respectable status.
options.B: to achieve a balance between tradition and reality.
options.C: to give voters more public figures to look up to.
options.D: due to their everlasting political embodiment.

questions.analysis: 事实细节题。根据题干关键词"monarchs"和"heads of state"，定位到第三段的最后一句话"...most royal families have survived because they allow voters to avoid the difficult search for a non-controversial but respected public figure."（大多数的王室幸存下来是由于他们让选民可以避免去寻找一个不受争议且受尊敬的公众人物的困难）其中"non-controversial but respected public figure"正是A选项中"undoubted and respectable status"的同义置换。故A是正确答案。

questions.stem: Which of the following is shown to be odd, according to Paragraph 4?

options.A: Aristocrats’ excessive reliance on inherited wealth.
options.B: The role of the nobility in modern democracies.
options.C: The simple lifestyle of the aristocratic families.
options.D: The nobility’s adherence to their privileges.

questions.analysis: 事实细节题。定位在第四段的最后一句话"...it is bizarre that wealthy aristocratic families should still be the symbolic heart of modern democratic states."（离奇的是，富有的贵族竟然仍是现代民主国家的象征核心）其中，the symbolic heart of modern democratic states是题干the role of the nobility in modern democracies的同义置换。

questions.stem: The British royals “have most to fear” because Charles ____

options.A: takes a tough line on political issues.
options.B: fails to change his lifestyle as advised.
options.C: takes republicans as his potential allies.
options.D: fails to adapt himself to his future role.

questions.analysis: 事实细节题。该题考查：英国皇家贵族们非常害怕是因为查尔斯……。根据题干专有名词Charles可定位到文章第七段"the danger will come with Charles...worst enemies"。本段指出"危险源自于查尔斯，他生活奢靡，等级观念显著；并且他没有意识到君王的幸存很大程度上取决于君王提供了公共服务，同时，查尔斯并不知道，国王才是君主制度最大的敌人，而非共和党人。"选项A意为：对待政治问题态度强硬，文章并无提及；选项B意为，对待建议的生活方式改变失败，文章中提到生活方式，但并未提到改变生活方式；选项C意为：视共和党人为潜在盟友，文章中提到，共和党人并非最大的敌人，并未指明把共和党人视为盟友，属于偷换概念，选项D意为：适应未来身份失败，文章指出查尔斯的生活方式，世界观以及他对于君王制度的错误理解均为身份特殊的他的不正确言行，与选项D表述吻合，故为正确答案。

questions.stem: Which of the following is the best title of the text?

options.B: Charles, Anxious to Succeed to the Throne.
options.C: Carlos, a Lesson for All European Monarchs.
options.D: Charles, Slow to React to the Coming Threats.

questions.analysis: 主旨大意题。该题考察四个选项中哪个可作为文章最佳标题。文章从西班牙国王Carlos退位事件切入，主要讨论当下欧洲君王制度所存在的问题，并非讨论查尔斯的事件，即可排除选项B"查尔斯-继位焦虑"和D"查尔斯-应对威胁缓慢"，而选项A"卡洛斯-荣辱并存" 和C"卡洛斯-欧洲君王们的前车之鉴"中，选项A属于细节信息，不能概括文章大意，选项C可概括，故为正确答案。另外，文章主题词Monarch只有在选项C中出现，也可作为迅速解题的依据。 Text 2
